LanguageData.RP_NewPrisonHandoverTip: The prison you take over has a past. A few secrets are already at work in the wings and on the payroll, and the old warden left a note about them that is right about some of them. Off, the prison starts clean.
LanguageData.RP_HandoverPractical: The state's shuttle brings convicts every day at {0}:00, and the state pays for each one (a grant on arrival, then a daily payment while they are with you).
LanguageData.RP_HandoverNote_Lead: To whoever has the keys now,\n\nThe state tells me my time at {0} is over, so I am writing down what I would want to know in your place. I have run it for the last quadrum and I am tired, and a tired person is wrong now and then - but I was right about most of it.
LanguageData.RP_HandoverHint_File: • I opened a file on {0} and never closed it. It is a suspicion and nothing I could put on paper - who {0} talks to, and for how long.
LanguageData.RP_HandoverHint_Crew: • Watch the {0} crew. Things go missing from there and I never caught who.
LanguageData.RP_HandoverHint_Dig: • Walk the {0} wing at night before you trust it. The officers there tell me it is quiet, and I have not been able to enjoy that. I never had the cells turned over.
LanguageData.RP_HandoverHint_Feud: • Two of the men in the {0} wing do not belong in the same room, and I never found the time to move either of them.
LanguageData.RP_HandoverNote_Sign: I wish you luck. You will need less of it than I did, I hope.\n\nYours, the old warden
LanguageData.RP_ChronicleBefore: Before you - the old warden's last weeks
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Intake: I signed for the quarter's big intake from the state. The wings are as full as I have ever had them, and I told the state so.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Pension: The state offered me a pension and a seat in the capital. I took the pension.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Lockdown: I locked the yard down for an afternoon after a scuffle. Nobody would say what it was about.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Sergeant: I lost my night sergeant to a transfer and gave the post to a guard from the floor. I hope it was the right call.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Yard: The yard has the same faces in it every afternoon now. I put it down to habit.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Books: I closed the quarter's books in the black, just, with the grant money and not a day to spare.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Inspector: The state's inspector came and went with a nod and a page of small print.
LanguageData.RP_Handover_Chr_Replaced: The state wrote that a new warden is on the way. I began my note that night.
